Similarly, learning to understand logic, patterns, change, evidence, and uncertainty helps us ask questions across fields. Each subject still requires its own practice.
গণিত, পদার্থবিজ্ঞান, রসায়ন ও জীববিজ্ঞানক: Mathematics, physics, chemistry, and biology seem to me like different languages for understanding nature. Their symbols, methods, and questions differ, yet they investigate interconnected aspects of the same world. Mathematics provides structures of reasoning, while empirical sciences test ideas about nature through observation and experiment. Statistics helps us understand uncertainty in that evidence.

রায়: ২৭ জুন ২০২৩ · মামলা নং 22–138 · গবে: Decided June 27, 2023 · Case No. 22–138 · A court judgment, not a research paper

The state must establish at least that the speaker consciously disregarded a substantial risk that the speech would be understood as a threat of violence (recklessness). The Supreme Court vacated the earlier judgment and remanded the case.
এই রায় true threats নিয়ে; আসন্ন বেআইনি ক: This judgment concerns true threats; the standard for incitement to imminent unlawful action is different.
